  - text: |
      <link rel="alternate" hreflang="nl" href="https://booneemma.github.io/contact.html">

---

```{=html}
<main>

<!-- ===== PAGE HEAD ===== -->
<section class="page-head">
  <div class="page-head-inner">
    <p class="kicker">Contact</p>
    <h1 class="d-title">Contact</h1>
    <p class="lede">Ready for the start? One message is enough.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===== CONTACT ===== -->
<section class="section">
  <div class="section-inner contact-grid">

    <div class="contact-list rv">
      <div class="contact-item contact-places">
        <h3>Practices</h3>
        <p><strong>Tondel – Huis voor psychotherapie</strong><br>Stropstraat 15, 9000 Gent</p>
        <p><strong>Drongen practice</strong><br>9031 Gent</p>
        <p>Sessions are also possible online.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="contact-item">
        <h3>Online</h3>
        <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/emmaboone" target="_blank" rel="noopener">LinkedIn</a></p>
      </div>
      <p class="contact-note">
        I reply within two working days.<br><br>
        <strong>In crisis or thinking about suicide?</strong> Don't wait for an appointment.
        Call <a href="tel:1813">1813</a> (Zelfmoordlijn, suicide prevention line) or <a href="tel:112">112</a> in an emergency.
      </p>
    </div>

    <div class="contact-form rv rv-1">
      <h3>Send a message</h3>
      <p class="form-intro">Please don't share sensitive details here yet; we will discuss those in a first conversation.</p>
      <form id="contactForm" action="https://api.web3forms.com/submit" method="POST"
            data-msg-sending="Sending…"
            data-msg-error="Something went wrong. Please try again later or send a message via LinkedIn.">
        <!-- TODO: access key van web3forms.com invullen (mag publiek staan) -->
        <input type="hidden" name="access_key" value="WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY">
        <input type="hidden" name="subject" value="Nieuw bericht via de website (Engelstalig)">
        <input type="hidden" name="from_name" value="Website Emma Boone">
        <!-- Without JavaScript, Web3Forms shows its own success page -->
        <input type="hidden" name="redirect" value="https://web3forms.com/success">
        <input type="checkbox" name="botcheck" class="form-hp" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true">
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="name">Name</label>
          <input type="text" id="name" name="name" autocomplete="name" required>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="email">Email</label>
          <input type="email" id="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" required>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="role">I am</label>
          <select id="role" name="role">
            <option value="sporter">An athlete</option>
            <option value="student">A student</option>
            <option value="doctorandus">A PhD candidate</option>
            <option value="coach">A coach or club</option>
            <option value="andere">Something else</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="form-group">
          <label for="message">Message</label>
          <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="6" required placeholder="What would you like to work on? A few sentences are enough."></textarea>
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="btn">Send</button>
        <p class="form-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </form>
      <div class="form-thanks" hidden>
        <p><strong>Thank you for your message!</strong></p>
        <p>I will reply within two working days.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</section>

</main>
```
